# JWS Custom Fitness Program

> A personalised 4–8 week workout program built from your answers by JWS Fitness (Journey With Shannon). Answer 15 questions in a Telegram bot, preview your program free, then unlock the full branded PDF for AU$7.99 one-time.

Programs are built around each person's goal, training days, session length, available equipment (full gym, home dumbbells, or bodyweight) and injuries, on Shannon's methodology — the JWS 4-week rep wave (reps fall as load rises; week four is a strength expression). Delivered in Telegram as a PDF with per-day exercise tables, week-by-week progression, warm-up and recovery guidance, and a printable session tracker.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://jws-program-landing.journeywithshannon.com/): the program, how it works, pricing and FAQ
- [Start in Telegram](https://t.me/JWS_Fitness_Bot?start=custom_program): the bot that builds your program
- [Journey app](https://app.journeywithshannon.com/): the JWS daily check-in and progress-photo tracker for iPhone
